name: Big White Room
summary:
Welcome to Big White Room. A place with no color... just endless white space and a whole lot of satisfyingly realistic physics objects. Your goal? Experiment, build, interact, and maybe find a way out.

This isn't about complex riddles; it's a hands-on VR physics playground. Get creative with our awesome physics engine – stack crates impossibly high, build wobbly towers, send spheres flying, and see how things satisfyingly tumble and crash.
